title: ASCII Business Card
description:
**Goal:** Print a boxed card from user info using helper functions.
```
+--------------------------------+
|  Ada Lovelace                  |
|  Software Engineer             |
|  ada@example.com               |
+--------------------------------+
```
requirements: Use `std::setw` with `std::left` to pad rows to the same width
stretch: draw a little ASCII logo next to the name.
